Proof in the paper: The crystalline structure of the resulting Sn-In alloy nanoparticles was examined by XRD measurements. From Fig. 1a, SnIn-3 (the sample prepared at the Sn:In molar ratio of 3:1) exhibit a series of well-defined diffraction peaks that are indexed to InSn4 (JCPDS: 48-1547) at 2θ = 29.7° (001), 32.0° (100), 44.3° (101), 57.1° (110), 65.8° (111), 67.0° (200), 71.4° (102), and 75.1° (201).
